Shalini Pandey Condemns Deepfake AI Video of Herself

Actor Shalini Pandey has condemned a "deeply disturbing" artificial intelligence-generated video of herself that has been circulating online. She stated, "I strongly condemn this kind of abuse." The video's creation and dissemination are being described as a form of abuse.
